issue_context.title: Swiss public transport not generating unique IDs: only one entity is present
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Both when using the new UI and the YAML configuration for the integration, the first entry gets properly created (with a sensor) but the second one only shows up in the entries but does not have an entity associated.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2024.1.0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

2023.12.4

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Swiss public transport

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/swiss_public_transport

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
sensor:
  - name: lausanne_geneve
    platform: swiss_public_transport
    from: "Lausanne"
    to: "Genève"
  - name: geneve_lausanne
    platform: swiss_public_transport
    from: "Genève"
    to: "Lausanne"
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
2024-01-04 10:04:12.476 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.sensor] Platform swiss_public_transport does not generate unique IDs. ID None_departure already exists - ignoring sensor.epfl_to_preverenges_departure
2024-01-04 10:04:12.481 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.sensor] Platform swiss_public_transport does not generate unique IDs. ID None_departure already exists - ignoring sensor.epfl_to_preverenges_departure
```


### Additional information

_No response_

review_comments:
It's generally safer to update the device entry and remove the config entry id instead of directly removing the device. If there are no more config entries connected to the device, the device registry will remove the device automatically.

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/8e83356ccb1c94cbbc06ca96da11d520387d923b/homeassistant/helpers/device_registry.py#L644

Shouldn't we keep the current major version?
```suggestion
    VERSION = 1
    MINOR_VERSION = 2
```

Please use `async_update_entry` to update the unique id instead.

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/8e83356ccb1c94cbbc06ca96da11d520387d923b/homeassistant/config_entries.py#L1351

Shouldn't we abort if there's already an existing config entry with this unique id? Move this up to the top and use our other helper instead of checking for matching config entry data.

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/8e83356ccb1c94cbbc06ca96da11d520387d923b/homeassistant/config_entries.py#L1567
We can replace that line with the method I linked above if we move setting the unique id up top when handling the user input.
If I understand correctly, you prefer using `abort_if_unique_id_configured` to `async_abort_entries_match`?
Yes. We set a unique_id, then we should use that abort method.
If the migration changes in the future, this log message may not make sense anymore. I'd log both major and minor version.
We don't need to add the mock config entry within the patch context manager. Move this to the top.
